title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
original_title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
summary: Predicting how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types and disease.
title_zh: DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，解读细胞如何读取 DNA
lead_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，用于预测 DNA 序列及其变异对特定人类细胞类型和疾病的影响，帮助理解致病机制。

body_zh.heading: 发生了什么
paras: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布新一代 DNA 序列模型 AlphaGenome 2，用来预测 DNA 序列及其变异如何影响特定的人类细胞类型，从而帮助科学家找出疾病背后的细胞层面原因。它把单细胞生物学和人类遗传学联系起来，可预测遗传变异对数百种人类细胞类型的影响。
去年发布的第一代 AlphaGenome 只能在较宽泛的组织层面预测变异效应，团队还推出了 AlphaGenome Atlas，收录人类基因组全部 **90 亿**种可能单字母变化的预测。新模型训练数据超过 **1 亿**份单细胞图谱，覆盖 **68** 种组织，并重新设计了模型处理细胞类型的方式。
AlphaGenome 2 现已通过 AlphaGenome API 向非商业研究开放，商业研究则处于私有预览阶段。

body_zh.heading: DeepMind 怎么说
paras: 据 DeepMind 称，与此前最好的模型相比，AlphaGenome 2 能识别出近 **2 倍**数量的、会改变细胞基因表达的变异，还能对模型从未见过的细胞状态和疾病状态做出预测，捕捉到组织级模型容易漏掉的疾病相关细胞中的效应。

fulltext.author: Adam Gayoso, Natasha Latysheva, Pushmeet Kohli and Å½iga Avsec

fulltext.title_zh: AlphaGenome 2：解读细胞如何读取 DNA，以更好地理解疾病

blocks.zh: 我们的下一代 DNA 序列模型连接了单细胞生物学与人类遗传学，可预测基因变异如何影响数百种人类细胞类型。
blocks.en: Our next-generation DNA sequence model bridges single-cell biology and human genetics, predicting how genetic variants affect hundreds of human cell types.

blocks.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出 AlphaGenome 2，这是我们的下一代模型，可预测 DNA 序列及其变异如何影响特定的人类细胞类型，为科学家提供了一个强大的新工具，用于揭示疾病背后的细胞驱动因素。
blocks.en: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.

blocks.zh: 细胞是生命的基本单元。我们体内的每个细胞都携带同一份 DNA 蓝图，但每种细胞类型和状态（比如心肌细胞，或正在对抗感染的免疫细胞）会开启或关闭不同的基因来完成各自的工作。人类细胞图谱等全球性项目正在绘制数百万个细胞的基因表达图谱，但预测细微的 DNA 变异如何影响细胞中的这种表达仍是一个未解的难题，而这正是人类性状和疾病的关键驱动因素。
blocks.en: Cells are the building blocks of life. Every cell in our body carries the same DNA blueprint, yet each cell type and stateâlike a heart muscle cell or an immune cell fighting an infectionâswitches different genes on or off to do its job. Global efforts like the Human Cell Atlas are mapping this gene expression for millions of cells, but it is still an unsolved challenge to predict how subtle DNA variations affect this expression in cells, which is a key driver of human traits and disease.

blocks.zh: 去年，我们推出了 AlphaGenome，用于预测 DNA 变异如何影响广泛组织中的分子活动。我们又通过 AlphaGenome Atlas 扩大了它的覆盖范围，这是一个包含人类基因组全部 90 亿种可能的单字母变化的预测结果的平台。这些工具帮助研究人员对变异效应进行优先排序和解读，推动罕见病、复杂性状和基础生物学领域的发现。
blocks.en: Last year, we launched AlphaGenome to predict how DNA variants affect molecular activity across broad tissues. We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas, a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome. These tools help researchers prioritize and interpret variant effects, driving discoveries in rare diseases, complex traits, and fundamental biology.

blocks.zh: AlphaGenome 2 从广泛的组织平均值放大到单个细胞类型和细胞状态，并重新设计了模型架构，使变异预测性能实现了跃升。重要的是，它让研究人员能够预测在广泛组织模型中会被遗漏的、与疾病相关的细胞中的变异效应，也能对模型从未见过的细胞状态和疾病状态做出预测。
blocks.en: By zooming in from broad tissue averages to individual cell types and cell states, and redesigning the modelâs architecture, AlphaGenome 2 represents a step-change improvement in variant predictive performance. Importantly, it allows researchers to predict variant effects in disease-relevant cells that would be missed in broad-tissue models, as well as predictions for cell and disease states that the model hasnât seen before.

blocks.zh: 与我们之前最先进的模型相比，AlphaGenome 2 找出的改变细胞基因表达的变异数量接近两倍。该模型在 68 种组织的超过 1 亿个单细胞图谱上训练，把静态的细胞图谱变成了人类遗传学的预测引擎。AlphaGenome 2 今天即可通过 AlphaGenome API 用于非商业研究，并面向商业研究开放私有预览。
blocks.en: AlphaGenome 2 identifies nearly twice as many variants that change gene expression in cells, compared to our previous state-of-the-art model. Trained on more than 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, the model turns static cell atlases into a predictive engine for human genetics. AlphaGenome 2 is available today for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API, and in private preview for commercial research.

blocks.zh: 为特定细胞类型重新设计 AlphaGenome
blocks.en: Redesigning AlphaGenome for specific cell types

blocks.caption_zh: 对比 AlphaGenome 1 和 2 处理细胞类型的方式。AlphaGenome 从一段 100 万个字母的 DNA 序列出发，并行输出固定的整体组织和细胞系结果。AlphaGenome 2 是一个条件模型，它在输入 DNA 序列的同时接收一个特定的生物学条件，这个条件可以从细胞类型参考目录中选择，也可以通过我们的细胞编码器，根据科学家自己的单细胞实验即时生成。

blocks.zh: 第一代 AlphaGenome 模型输入一段 100 万个字母的 DNA 序列，同时预测来自多种组织的数千个实验的各项属性。这种并行方式虽然高效，但把模型的能力摊得很薄，难以捕捉亲缘关系相近的细胞类型之间的细微差异。
blocks.en: The first AlphaGenome model took a million-letter DNA sequence and predicted properties across thousands of experiments from many tissues all at once. While efficient, this parallel approach spread the modelâs capacity thin and made it hard to capture subtle differences between closely related cell types.

blocks.zh: 为改进这一点，我们从根本上重新设计了模型处理细胞类型的方式。AlphaGenome 2 不再并行预测，而是一个条件模型，每次针对一个条件（定义为一种组织、细胞类型或状态）预测 DNA 的效应。除了 100 万个字母的 DNA 序列之外，它在架构的每一个阶段都把目标生物学条件作为输入。这使它能够学到同一段 DNA 在不同细胞类型中是如何被以不同方式读取的。
blocks.en: To improve this, we fundamentally redesigned how cell types are treated by the model. Instead of predicting in parallel, AlphaGenome 2 is a conditional model that predicts DNA effects for one condition - defined as a tissue, cell type or state - at a time. Alongside the million-letter DNA sequence, it uses the target biological condition as input at every stage of its architecture. This allows it to learn how the same stretch of DNA is read differently across cell types.

blocks.zh: 条件模型还支持跨模态补全，使 AlphaGenome 2 能够预测缺失的实验数据。该模型把细胞的生物学状态与其输出分开，因此如果科学家只输入一种测量结果，比如单细胞基因活性，AlphaGenome 2 就可以预测未测量的属性，比如染色质可及性。这可以帮助研究人员确定接下来优先做哪些实验。
blocks.en: A conditional model also allows cross-modality imputation, enabling AlphaGenome 2 to predict missing experimental data. The model separates a cellâs biological state from its outputs, so if a scientist inputs just one measurement, like single-cell gene activity, AlphaGenome 2 can then predict unmeasured properties, such as chromatin accessibility. This can then help researchers prioritize which experiments to do next.

blocks.zh: 我们用来自人类和小鼠样本的整体组织数据和单细胞数据训练了 AlphaGenome 2，其中包括超过 1.07 亿个单细胞图谱。AlphaGenome 2 超越了原模型的整体组织平均值，能够解析特化细胞内部的活动（例如不同的心肌细胞或血液免疫细胞），帮助找出只在特定细胞类型中起作用的关键 DNA 变异。
blocks.en: We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles. Moving beyond the bulk tissue averages of the original model, AlphaGenome 2 can resolve activity inside specialized cellsâsuch as distinct heart muscle or blood immune cellsâto help uncover crucial DNA variants that act only in specific cell types.

blocks.zh: 该模型预测的核心实验读数与 AlphaGenome 相同，例如基因表达、组蛋白修饰和染色质可及性，此外还有 DNA 甲基化，这是一个被广泛要求的读数。
blocks.en: The model predicts the same core experimental readouts of DNA function as AlphaGenome â such as gene expression, histone modifications and chromatin accessibility â but also DNA methylation, a widely requested readout.

blocks.zh: 最先进的细胞类型预测和变异召回
blocks.en: State-of-the-art cell-type predictions and variant recall

blocks.zh: AlphaGenome 2 在预测特定细胞中的基因调控方面明显更好，帮助研究人员锁定与疾病相关的变异。
blocks.en: AlphaGenome 2 is significantly better at predicting gene regulation in specific cells, helping researchers pinpoint disease-relevant variants.

blocks.zh: • 细胞类型特异性提升 在训练数据之外的基因组区域，AlphaGenome 2 能更充分地解释同一组织内不同细胞类型之间基因表达的差异，追踪基因表达的连续变化，比如人类血液干细胞成熟为红细胞和免疫谱系的过程。
blocks.en: • Improved cell type specificity On genome regions outside its training data, AlphaGenome 2 explains significantly more of how gene expression differs across cell types within a tissueâtracking continuous changes in gene expression, such as when human blood stem cells mature into red blood cells and immune lineages.

blocks.zh: • 变异效应预测提升 在 TenK10K 数据集（一个包含 28 种原代免疫细胞类型的大型单细胞图谱）上，AlphaGenome 2 可靠识别出的因果变异（30% 对 16%）和基因方向性效应（43% 对 23%）数量接近原版 AlphaGenome（在单细胞数据上微调）及其他专用工具的两倍。这种精度帮助研究人员发现被忽视的候选变异，用于新的发现。
blocks.en: • Improved variant effect prediction On the TenK10K dataset, a large single-cell map of 28 primary immune cell types, AlphaGenome 2 reliably identified nearly twice as many causal variants (30% vs. 16%) and directional gene effects (43% vs. 23%) as the original AlphaGenome fine-tuned on single-cell data and other specialized tools. This precision helps researchers find overlooked candidate variants for new discoveries.

blocks.zh: • 锁定与疾病相关的变异 最近一项里程碑式的研究表明，一个远端调控开关中的变异通过过度激活肠道免疫细胞（巨噬细胞）中的 ETS2 基因而导致 IBD。AlphaGenome 2 对肠道中多种免疫细胞类型做出预测，在计算上重现了这一发现。它挑出了因果变异，并显示该变异选择性地增强肠道巨噬细胞中的 ETS2 基因，而其他细胞类型和基因基本不受影响。
blocks.en: • Pinpointing disease-relevant variants A recent landmark study showed that a variant in a distant regulatory switch drives IBD by overactivating the ETS2 gene in gut immune cells (macrophages). Making predictions across various immune cell types in the gut, AlphaGenome 2 reproduced this finding computationally. It singled out the causal variant and showed that it selectively boosts the ETS2 gene in gut macrophages, leaving other cell types and genes largely unaffected.

blocks.caption_zh: AlphaGenome 2 的预测更接近观测到的基因表达。这是成熟中的红细胞（即造血过程）的基因表达热图，显示按行归一化（Z 分数）的观测值（左）、AG2 的预测（中）以及在单细胞数据上微调的 AG1 的预测（右）。每张热图中，不同基因排在水平行上，造血分化的连续阶段排在垂直行上。

blocks.zh: 无需重新训练即可分析新的细胞类型和状态
blocks.en: Analyzing new cell types and states without retraining

blocks.zh: AlphaGenome 2 还能泛化到全新的单细胞实验，而无需重新训练。科学家可以上传仅来自几十个细胞的基因活性单细胞 RNA-seq 快照；这些基因活性会先被压缩成细胞状态表示，再用来让模型以未见过的状态为条件。AlphaGenome 2 可以媲美甚至超越直接在这些数据集上训练或微调的模型。
blocks.en: AlphaGenome 2 can also generalize to entirely new single-cell experiments without needing to be retrained. Scientists can upload a single-cell RNA-seq snapshot of gene activity from just a few dozen cells; this gene activity is then compressed into a cell state representation, before being used to condition the model on unseen states. AlphaGenome 2 can match or outperform models trained or fine-tuned directly on those datasets.

blocks.zh: 这使 AlphaGenome 2 能够预测新细胞状态下的变异效应和基因调控，比如由疾病或疫苗接种产生的状态。例如，面对一项 COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗研究中未见过的单细胞数据，AlphaGenome 2 区分出了被疫苗激活的免疫 T 细胞和静息的 T 细胞。它还揭示，与重症 COVID-19 相关的一个变异在细胞处于这种激活状态时对基因活性的破坏更强，而这种效应在未激活的细胞中会被遗漏。
blocks.en: This enables AlphaGenome 2 to predict variant effects and gene regulation for new cell states, such as those that occur from disease or vaccination. For example, given unseen single-cell data from a COVID-19 mRNA vaccine study, AlphaGenome 2 distinguished vaccine-activated immune T cells from resting ones. It also revealed that a variant linked to severe COVID-19 disrupts gene activity more strongly when cells are in this activated state â an effect that would be missed in unactivated cells.

blocks.zh: 连接人类遗传学与单细胞生物学
blocks.en: Bridging human genetics and single-cell biology

blocks.zh: 更好地理解疾病的一种方式，是把人类遗传学与细胞生物学联系起来。建立这一联系的重要一环，是把全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中发现的数千个与性状和疾病相关的变异，与不断扩展的人体单细胞图谱连接起来。
blocks.en: One way to better understand disease is by linking human genetics to cell biology. An important part of building this link requires connecting the thousands of trait and disease-associated variants found in genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to the growing single-cell maps of the human body.

blocks.zh: 为了帮助研究人员建立这些联系而不必自己进行大规模计算，我们预先计算了 AlphaGenome 2 对数百种人类细胞和组织条件下性状相关变异的预测，以应对两大挑战：
blocks.en: To help researchers make these connections without running large-scale computations themselves, we precomputed AlphaGenome 2 predictions for trait-associated variants across hundreds of human cell and tissue conditions, tackling two major challenges:

blocks.zh: • 在真实的人类细胞类型中绘制增强子与基因的联系：许多与疾病相关的变异位于称为增强子的远端调控开关中，使其效应难以追踪。由于实验性 CRISPR 筛选大多使用稳定的实验室培养细胞系，科学家往往缺少人体内特定细胞的这类线路图。AlphaGenome 2 把增强子与基因的映射扩展到了原代人类细胞类型，比如支持并保护神经元的脑星形胶质细胞，帮助研究人员在疾病发生的特定细胞中，把调控变异与其靶基因联系起来。
blocks.en: • Mapping enhancerâgene links in real human cell types: Many disease-linked variants sit in distant regulatory switches called enhancers, making their effects hard to trace. Because experimental CRISPR screens mostly use stable, lab-grown cell lines, scientists often lack these wiring diagrams for specific cells in the human body. AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types â such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons â helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

blocks.zh: • 锁定因果 GWAS 变异及其起作用的细胞：全基因组关联研究会标出与疾病相关的大段 DNA，但研究人员往往无法随后以高置信度找到确切的因果变异、靶基因和细胞类型。在从身高到 2 型糖尿病的多种复杂性状上，AlphaGenome 2 预先计算的变异分数有助于锁定最可能涉及的具体变异和细胞类型。在有把握时，该模型还能准确预测某个变异是让基因活性升高还是降低，这是理解该基因如何导致疾病的关键线索。
blocks.en: • Pinpointing causal GWAS variants and the cells where they act: Genome-wide association studies flag broad stretches of DNA linked to disease, but researchers canât always then find the exact causal variant, target gene, and cell type with high confidence. Across a number of complex traits, ranging from height to type 2 diabetes, AlphaGenome 2âs precomputed variant scores help pinpoint the specific variants and cell types most likely to be involved. When confident, the model also accurately predicts whether a variant turns a geneâs activity up or down â a critical clue for understanding how that gene contributes to disease.

blocks.zh: 与科学界一起展望未来
blocks.en: Looking ahead with the scientific community

blocks.zh: 随着科学家在单细胞水平上绘制出更多的人体图谱，AI 模型将变得越来越强大。通过我们持续的合作，包括与 Wellcome Sanger Institute 的研究人员合作，我们正努力刻画更广泛的人类细胞类型、发育谱系和受扰动的细胞状态。我们期待看到整个科学界的研究人员如何利用 AlphaGenome 2 及其改进的细胞类型特异性预测，来揭示遗传变异如何在各种细胞中起作用，以及这对基础生物学和疾病意味着什么。
blocks.en: As scientists map more of the human body at the single-cell level, AI models will continue to become more powerful. Through our ongoing collaborations, including with researchers at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, we are working to profile an even wider spectrum of human cell types, developmental lineages, and perturbed cellular states. We look forward to seeing how researchers from across the community use AlphaGenome 2 and its improved cell-type specific predictions to uncover how genetic variants act across cells,Â and what that reveals about basic biology and disease.

blocks.zh: AlphaGenome 2 以及用于表达条件化的交互式 Colab 教程今天即可通过 AlphaGenome API 用于非商业研究，并面向商业研究开放私有预览。我们很快还将在我们的智能体开发平台 Google Antigravity 中发布 AlphaGenome 2 Skills。像 AlphaGenome 2 这样的专用模型，与 Antigravity 中 Gemini 4 这样强大的智能体科学工具相结合，将帮助科学家加速研究并取得新发现。
blocks.en: AlphaGenome 2, and interactive Colab tutorials for expression conditioning are available today for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API and in private preview for commercial research. And soon, we will release AlphaGenome 2 Skills in Google Antigravity, our agentic development platform. The combination of specialized models, like AlphaGenome 2, with powerful agentic science tools like Gemini 4 in Antigravity, will help scientists accelerate research and make new discoveries.

blocks.zh: 我们非常感谢可信测试者社区对 AlphaGenome 2 的反馈，也感谢许多帮助创建其训练数据集的个人和研究人员。我们希望重点展示社区可以借鉴的 AlphaGenome 2 有趣用例。请在 11 月 30 日前通过这份表单与我们联系；入选的项目可能获得额外的配额和额度。我们也希望在社区意见的指引下确定未来的路线图，请在我们的社区论坛分享你的反馈和想法。
blocks.en: We are hugely grateful to our community of trusted testers for their feedback on AlphaGenome 2, as well as the many individuals and researchers that helped create the datasets used to train it. We'd love to spotlight interesting AlphaGenome 2 use cases the community can learn from. Get in touch via this form by 30 November; selected projects may be eligible for additional quota and credits. We also want to be guided by community input to shape our future roadmap, please share your feedback and ideas in our community forum.

blocks.zh: 请注意，AlphaGenome 和 AlphaGenome 2 仅供研究使用，尚未经过临床或诊断用途的验证或批准。
blocks.en: Please note that AlphaGenome and AlphaGenome 2 are intended for research use only and have not been validated or approved for clinical or diagnostic purposes.
